checkpoints.description: [1/3] Planning: UI and visual overhaul across Armory, Statistics, Main Menu, Field Manual Relics, and Combat Boss HUD

impact_assessment.why: Visual audit revealed uncentered Armory rows with crammed buy buttons, unpaneled Kills-by-Type section on Stats, hollow 140px center hole on Main Menu buttons, missing relic glyphs in Manual, and raw unrounded rectangular Boss HUD bar
impact_assessment.benefits: Centered balanced Armory with currency badge, tactical Kills-by-Type panel, unified Main Menu column with career badge, illustrated relic codex, sleek tactical boss health bar, and luminous XP gems
impact_assessment.risks: contract: button IDs and layout tests for Armory and Stats must pass; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve all existing button IDs, coordinate invariants (need.y + 6 <= next.y - 17, kills.y > best.y + 16), and verify with test suite and CDP screenshots

[1/5] Auditing deterministic room generation, prop collision, encounter hooks, sprite paths, animation state, and renderer constraints.

impact_assessment.why: Open arenas and isolated props leave room-scale navigation and encounter identity underdeveloped.
impact_assessment.benefits: Seed-stable room landmarks, stronger spatial readability, reusable visual hooks, and testable encounter surfaces.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: room collision and encounter changes can affect movement; dependency: room data must integrate with existing props/hazards; concurrency: existing dirty AIKit files must remain untouched; state: save data must remain compatible.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse deterministic hash generation, preserve existing prop APIs and save fields, gate new encounters behind room-local state, and add focused regression tests.
